simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲסֵפָה (H626) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֲסֵפָה (ʼăçêphâh) means a collection of people (only adverbial) First listed occurrence: Isa 24 22.

definitions.full: H626. asephah אֲסֵפָה noun feminine verbal. a collecting, gathering ; א ׳אֻסְּפוּ אַסִּיר Isa 24:22 they are collected, as a collecting captives unto a pit (dungeon); or they are gathered with a gathering (as) captives , compare 22:18 ; but perhaps read הָאַסִּיר אֹסֶף (construct); see Weir Che.
